title: Decoding blocks of a concatenated chunk word
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $f$ assign a cell value to each natural number, and let $m$ be a natural number. Decoding the first $m$ blocks of the concatenation of the first $m$ encoded cell values gives, in order, the values $f(0),\ldots,f(m-1)$, each represented as a successfully decoded cell value.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$f$ maps natural numbers to cell values
